blocks.text: The main purpose of truth tables is to show how a logical expression behaves. They help us find when a statement is true or false. Truth tables list all possible input values. They help remove confusion in logical reasoning. Using truth tables, we can check complex expressions easily. They help compare different logical statements. Truth tables are useful in decision-making. They are important tools in logic and computer science.
